In detail

Döbling is Vienna's affluent northern district (including Grinzing and Heiligenstadt); a targeted search for tourist- or Heuriger-related crime around Grinzing/Heiligenstadt returned nothing, and general street crime in the district actually declined in the latest reporting period aside from car break-ins (75 to 96 cases) and bicycle theft (94 to 110), per the 2024 district crime statistics. The one genuine concern in recent press is a sharp rise in youth-related robbery: police recorded a 222% increase in robbery cases over a six-month comparison (9 to 29), concentrated in March–April 2026 and attributed to a small group of repeat offenders, several under age 14 and thus below the age of criminal responsibility, prompting the district chief to meet Austria's interior minister in June 2026. Cybercrime targeting IT systems/data also rose sharply (330 to 476 cases, 2023–2024), but that is a remote-fraud risk rather than a street-safety one. Given the youth-robbery spike is a real, recent, specific pattern, a modest night-time caution is warranted while daytime remains without documented concern. Sources checked: meinbezirk.at, "Kriminalstatistik des Bezirks: Cybercrime nimmt in Döbling immer mehr zu" (7 May 2025); Heute.at, "Jugendkriminalität in Döbling – Plus 222% bei Raub" (8 June 2026); OTS/FPÖ press release (17 June 2026).
